audit_notes: Power: observed partial R^2 0.00001 vs MDE 0.00132 at n=5957 (80% power, alpha 0.05) — the design was underpowered for an effect of the observed size; the null result rules out large effects, not small ones.
conclusion_scope: Primary test failed its preregistered criteria (3 of 3 failed; see evidence.verdict_criteria). The rejection is about the preregistered effect at the preregistered threshold, not a claim that no effect of any size exists.

cost_gate.note: Informational only: no costs applied. VIX is not tradable; no free VIX futures series exists to measure roll costs (Yahoo VX=F returns no data). Not a verdict criterion.

limitations: The 2-trading-day BAA10Y publication lag was verified only at fetch time and is assumed constant over the historical sample; FRED's posting schedule may have changed over 2003-2026.
FRED revisions are unmodelled; the trial uses the current vintage, not as-first-posted values.
Same-day comovement is positive (see the study report descriptives); the rejection is about next-day carryover, not about same-day transmission.
The informational gross sign-rule edge is positive but its confidence interval includes zero; it is descriptive only, on an untradable index, and not a verdict criterion.
